evidence: The paper uses random forest models exclusively as reference predictors for establishing baseline prediction accuracy on a single-cell signaling task. Random forests appear in two contexts: (1) as a reference model: "A reference model was built using a random forest predictor before the challenge" (SC1, SC2, SC4 reference models), and (2) as one algorithm in an ensemble by one team: "They used subsets of these features to train an ensemble of models: ElasticNet, ExtraTrees, RandomForest, Light Gradient Boosting, and linear model." Variable importance metrics are never discussed, analyzed, or used for any purpose.
